fusion.score: higher better: half maximum plus half mean event credit; event credit is mean across complete original banks of max alternative-variant normalized reciprocal rank 61/(60+rank)
fusion.rank_population: all eligible duplicate groups per variant and bank, deterministic distance/recording/native-bound ties
fusion.variants: explicit same-event parent/native-support association only; max credit, never extra votes; identical PCM and copied bank references deduplicate
fusion.events: unordered distinct examples unless explicitly validated as alternative representations; favors any strong match and agreement, no temporal-sequence meaning
fusion.missing: primary fusion requires identical complete original populations; partial banks diagnostic only; missing components are unscored, not negative
fusion.support: top sixteen raw rows per variant/bank/group before overlap consolidation; at most three non-overlapping representative passages per track, truncation explicit
fusion.grouping: greedy representative-anchored intersection/min-length >=0.5; positive intersection; same recording; envelope <=8s; no transitive chains; adjacent intervals separate; final secondary representatives must not overlap
fusion.ties: distance then recording/start/end/row ID; fusion descending credit then group ID; input, shard, bank and event order do not matter

development.truth: familiar procedural development families, alternate performances; exact-tail separate; hybrid contains pluck and fm at disjoint native intervals; excluded/absent positives excluded from recall denominators; silence three explicit failures
development.metrics: hit@1/5/10/20 at least one eligible known group; recall all eligible positives at20; passage overlap >= half true-event frames in retained actual scored row; full containment, IoU and boundary error reported separately; losses decomposed before cap, after cap/grouping and shortlist
development.stop: one fixed batch, no sweep/replacement/deleted losses; preserve baseline regardless of findings

accounting: each case-policy evaluation and each delivery arm counts one query job; diagnostics two jobs; invocation overhead, audits, every source/cue decode, retries and one reuse validation charged; fixed 64 MiB metadata envelope; no discovery feature construction or separator processing
scope: C02 only; no human relevance claim, finer timing, query-dependent extraction or general cache management
